# Incident report: checkout failures, 2026-11-05

**Status:** Mitigated. Checkout error rates are back under 1%.
**Severity:** SEV1 (checkout-web error rate peaked at 17.6%, above the 10% threshold)
**Window:** 14:02 UTC (onset) to 14:30 UTC (flag reverted, metrics recovered)

## Impact
- checkout-web error rate rose from ~0.3% to 17.6% (alert alt_32, 14:06).
- payments-api p99 latency rose from ~420 ms to ~3150 ms (alert alt_31, 14:03).
- payments-api `POST /charge` returned 502 with "tax quote unavailable (TaxEngineV2)".
- About 18% of payment requests failed for roughly 28 minutes (14:02 to 14:30). Customers attempting checkout during that window saw failures.

## Timeline (UTC)
- 13:41: payments-api deployed v2.13.4 -> v2.14.0 (dep_7781). No errors followed it.
- 13:15: tax-service DB connection pool raised 50 -> 80 (cfg_0412). Not linked to the errors.
- 14:02: `tax_engine_v2` flag ramped 10% -> 100% on payments-api (flg_2210, release-train).
- 14:02:31: first TaxEngineV2 timeout calling tax-service /v2/quote (3000 ms).
- 14:03: payments-api p99 alert fires. tax-service logs p99 3021 ms and "shedding load".
- 14:03:30: checkout-web begins reporting payment-step failures (payments-api 502).
- 14:05: search-api deployed v5.2.0 -> v5.2.1 (dep_7790). Unrelated to the errors; see open items.
- 14:06: checkout-web 5xx alert fires.
- 14:08: tax-service reports "worker pool exhausted" on /v2/quote.
- 14:21: assessment begins (alerts, metrics, changes, logs reviewed).
- 14:29: `tax_engine_v2` rollout set back to 10% (previous value). Status page updated to "identified".
- 14:30: checkout-web error rate 0.4%; payments-api error rate 0.3%; payments p99 450 ms.
- 14:34: status page updated to "mitigated". Payments and tax-platform paged.

## Root cause
The `tax_engine_v2` flag ramp to 100% (flg_2210) sent all checkout traffic through TaxEngineV2. That path calls tax-service `/v2/quote`, which could not handle the load. Calls timed out at 3000 ms, tax-service shed load and then exhausted its worker pool, and payments-api returned 502 on `/charge`. The time of onset, the timeout errors, and the 502s all line up with that change. The search-api deploy at 14:05 came after onset and touches no part of this path, so it was not the cause.

## Mitigation
- Set `tax_engine_v2` rollout back to 10%, the value before the change. This was the least risky option under the runbook. No deploy was rolled back.
- Verified recovery: checkout-web error rate went from 17.6% to 0.4%, and payments-api error rate from 18.3% to 0.3%. Only the search-api latency warning remains.

## Open items / follow-ups
1. **Payments team:** decide when to re-ramp `tax_engine_v2`. Do not go back to 100% until tax-service capacity is confirmed. Review TaxEngineV2 timeout and fallback behaviour.
2. **Tax-platform team:** check `/v2/quote` worker pool sizing and the effect of cfg_0412 (pool 50 -> 80). Confirm the pool is healthy at 10% traffic.
3. **search-api (warning, alt_33):** p95 latency above 400 ms since 14:09, following dep_7790 at 14:05. It is not customer-blocking for checkout, so it was not rolled back. Its owning team should check it.
4. Improve the release process so a flag ramp to 100% on a checkout path needs a dependency capacity check first.

## Teams paged
- payments (high): flag state, re-ramp decision, TaxEngineV2 timeout handling.
- tax-platform (high): /v2/quote worker pool exhaustion and capacity.

## Status page updates
- 14:29 identified (SEV1): "Checkout errors for some customers".
- 14:34 mitigated (SEV1): same title.
